MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds fit my headphone use and could give me a compact option to carry with my laptop alongside my larger headphones.",
    "The ten-foot HDMI cable connects with my earlier cable and cable-management purchases, though I would only buy it if my existing six-foot cable cannot reach."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and smart plug assume I want voice control or home automation, but I have no specific need for either in my current setup.",
    "The streaming sticks do not address my recent laptop and wired-network needs; having bought an HDMI cable does not mean I need a streaming device.",
    "The tablet offers another device without a clear purpose for me, while my Kindle already covers reading. The portable speaker also misses my current focus on headphone listening."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in broadly popular gadgets, even when they serve very different purposes.",
    "My Kindle purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in other Amazon devices, although reading does not imply a need for Alexa or streaming hardware."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest interactions cluster around carrying, connecting, organizing, and maintaining computer equipment: a laptop backpack, Ethernet adapter and cables, headphone mount, and blower duster.",
    "What I already have matters: another cable needs to solve a reach problem, while compact earbuds offer a different use from my larger headphones.",
    "My Raspberry Pi and accessory purchases suggest specific setup projects, so a useful next item needs a clear connection to a task rather than simply being another electronic device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my cable and headphone needs but mostly interpreted practical computer-setup activity as general interest in smart-home and entertainment devices."
}
